name: Magic Wand
tagline: Mouse, HUD, scrolling and speech to text from three buttons on a wand.
summary: Turning the wand moves my Mac’s pointer or the Agentic Mouse HUD outline. A Puck.js at the tip reads the rotation and sends it over Bluetooth.
status: Ethan confirmed the latest native pointing feels much smoother; the other experimental gestures still need a physical check.
Held positioning clicks on release and resumes prior high sensitivity after 300 ms. Ethan confirmed the still-hand tolerance feels good.
HIGH dwell, held rough circles, desk inference and VS Code review pass automated checks; physical acceptance is pending.
End-to-end latency, accuracy and battery life haven’t been measured.

parts: Puck.js v2.1: gyro, Bluetooth and an RGB light
hardware.wiring: Each button connects its pin to GND. The Puck’s internal pull-ups make a press read low.

buttons.name: Middle
gestures: Open the HUD on Switch App, then turn the wand to move the outline
Use the outlined card on release
Hold the card; on some wheel cards, tilt to turn the wheel
Open the current app’s controls; double tap again to close
notes: The outline stops at the edges instead of wrapping.
Bottom goes back to the pointer.

VS Code app mode: hold Bottom and tilt down or up to review changes. Crossed files are staged on release through Better Git. Double tap Bottom to toggle file staging mode; green is change review and purple is file staging.
The browser demo shows the main HUD; native app-specific controls and desk detection need the installed integrations.

buttons.name: Bottom
gestures: Click once after a 450 ms pause
Aim at one-third speed; release clicks once
Aim at low sensitivity; release clicks, pauses 300 ms, then resumes HIGH
Drag with the actual mouse button held; release drops
notes: HIGH is released-button follow. LOW is a plain Bottom hold at one-third speed.
Hold Bottom and make a rough clockwise loop to scroll down, or anticlockwise to scroll up. Cyan shows recognition; release stops without an endpoint click.
Leave the wand idle on the desk for about two seconds to learn its resting pose. Picking it up can then enter HIGH automatically; setting it down stops following after sustained desk confirmation.
Agent Flow stops after about five seconds of confirmed desk rest during recording. Moving the wand cancels the pending stop.
Desk detection is an IMU estimate, not a touch sensor; a very still supported hand can resemble a desk. The browser demo covers the buttons, not physical desk detection.
Middle switches to the HUD. The pointer stays within real display edges.

chords.name: Bottom + Middle
gestures: Scroll sideways and up or down at once, including diagonals

lights.name: Calibrating
lights.detail: Keep it still with no buttons pressed for two seconds

lights.name: App review

lights.detail: Red, unless the pointer, HUD or scrolling is active

orientationCompensation.scope: Native mouse pointing; compensates wrist roll using existing gravity telemetry. Enable with orientationCompensation in the local feature-flags.json. No new movement buffer.
